summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026 furnishing a press release updating its 2026 share buy-back programme's third tranche, announced July 22, 2026 (US equivalent: issuer tender/buy-back disclosure). From September 28 to October 2, 2026, Equinor repurchased 720,335 own shares on Oslo Børs and other venues at a weighted average of NOK 399.9378, totaling roughly NOK 288.1 million. Cumulative tranche buy-backs reached 6,989,388 shares at NOK 395.3214 average, about NOK 2.76 billion. Equinor now holds 21,624,123 treasury shares, 0.90% of capital (0.44% excluding the share savings programme). Watch execution pace against the October 26, 2026 tranche deadline.
